players.product: industrial & electronics gases (N2, He, specialty) for fabs

quarterly_data.signal: Air Products' fiscal 2026 third-quarter earnings release lists, under electronics growth, an announced long-term agreement for Air Products San Fu to build, own and operate four large state-of-the-art air separation units, bulk gas supply systems and new underground pipeline systems supporting a semiconductor manufacturer's expansion in Taiwan. The release does not name the semiconductor manufacturer.
quarterly_data.figure: four large air separation units plus bulk gas supply systems and new underground pipeline systems (Taiwan)
